prompt_catalog.limited_hold_01: Hand-drawn 2D animation, locked camera, a young astronomer holds a telescope pose on a quiet painted rooftop, only breathing, blinking, and a few strands of hair move, stable flat colors.
prompt_catalog.limited_hold_02: Traditional cel animation, a cook pauses beside a simmering pot in a painted kitchen, held body pose with subtle steam and eye movement, static background, clean color regions.
prompt_catalog.limited_hold_03: 2D anime style, a passenger sits by a train window reading a letter, nearly held pose with a small blink and page tremble, fixed interior composition, restrained motion.
prompt_catalog.limited_hold_04: Limited animation, a guard stands under a streetlamp at night, locked-off shot, only coat hem and lamp moths move, painted background and stable character silhouette.
prompt_catalog.dialogue_01: Hand-drawn 2D dialogue scene, two characters seated across a cafe table, fixed medium shot, alternating mouth shapes and natural blinks only, stable faces and background.
prompt_catalog.dialogue_02: Anime close-up of a mechanic speaking calmly to someone off camera, subtle lip movement, one blink and slight head motion, fixed camera, consistent facial identity.
prompt_catalog.dialogue_03: Traditional 2D over-the-shoulder conversation in a library, restrained mouth and eye motion, no camera movement, bookshelves and clothing remain stable.
prompt_catalog.dialogue_04: Cel-animated radio host delivering a line at a desk microphone, small mouth shapes and hand gesture, locked camera, flat-shaded studio background remains unchanged.
prompt_catalog.cyclic_01: Side-view 2D animation of a traveler walking in a clean repeating cycle past a painted countryside, consistent limb lengths, steady lateral motion, no cuts.
prompt_catalog.cyclic_02: Hand-drawn cyclist pedaling in a smooth loop along a riverside path, repeating wheel and leg motion, stable character design, gentle background parallax.
prompt_catalog.cyclic_03: Anime character standing on a balcony while hair, scarf, and hanging flags sway in repeating wind cycles, fixed camera and stable flat colors.
prompt_catalog.cyclic_04: 2D workshop scene with a large fan and belt mechanism rotating cyclically while a technician watches, locked composition, clean repeated mechanical motion.
prompt_catalog.dense_motion_01: Energetic 2D chase through a crowded night market, multiple running characters, cloth and signs moving, lateral camera tracking, dense painted details and no cuts.
prompt_catalog.dense_motion_02: Hand-drawn fantasy duel with fast body motion, sparks, cloth, and crossing weapons, dynamic camera pan, consistent character identities in a dense scene.
prompt_catalog.dense_motion_03: Anime city intersection in heavy rain, camera pans across moving crowds, umbrellas, vehicles, reflections, and layered parallax, high motion throughout.
prompt_catalog.dense_motion_04: 2D aerial scene following a flock of birds through trees and clouds, rapid camera movement, overlapping subjects, detailed parallax, stable silhouettes without cuts.

strata.description: Static-heavy limited animation with held poses and sparse local motion.
Dialogue shots dominated by mouth, blink, and small gesture motion.
Repeated locomotion, wind, and mechanical cycles with moderate temporal change.
Camera motion, many subjects, occlusion, and dense temporal change.

pairwise_lpips_mean.rationale: Loose same-seed identity tripwire, deliberately separate from intrinsic quality and ineligible to rescue a quality failure.

pairwise_clip_distance_mean.rationale: Rejects gross same-seed semantic trajectory changes without borrowing a cross-seed content-distance scale.

pairwise_temporal_clip_distance_mean.rationale: Loose temporal identity sanity bound intended to catch changed motion trajectories rather than BF16-scale drift.

sampling.tail_policy: p05 and p95 across videos are diagnostic until at least 20 independent videos exist per prompt; frames never increase sample count

visual_selection.selection_timing: seed ranks fixed before holdout visibility

retuning_policy: no changes after any holdout result is visible
prior_results_policy: All results visible before this protocol was frozen remain measurement-only and cannot be promoted to an authoritative holdout.

ds_oracle_gate.quality_requirement: all horizon-indexed intrinsic floors and identity tripwires pass
ds_oracle_gate.decision: all conditions must pass before any DS policy implementation
